title: Clean IP Manager (Cloudflare)
summary: Scans candidate Cloudflare IPs on a config's own port, then replaces only the address inside the share link. SNI, Host and Path stay untouched. The header shows the detected proxy core.

items.title: Find Clean IP for a Config
items.description: Scans candidate IPs on the port taken from a config's share link and saves the IP you choose.
items.usage_tip: After applying you can push the updated config straight to Passwall.

items.title: Show / Edit Candidate IP List
items.description: Prints the candidate file path and its contents so you can edit it manually.
items.usage_tip: The default list is Cloudflare-focused; one IP per line and # starts a comment.

items.title: Show Last Scan Results
items.description: Displays the cached results of the most recent scan sorted by latency.
items.usage_tip: Results are cleared and rebuilt on every new scan.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: Saved configs keep their current address.
